title: Declaring a National Emergency to Secure the United States Bulk-Power System
date_evidence: August 26, 2026 (date line at top of the presidential action page)
key_claim: The order lets the Secretary of Energy recognise equipment and vendors as pre-qualified and exempt, impose conditions on foreign equipment acquired or installed before the order, and requires implementing rules within 120 days.

title: US executive order banning Chinese bulk-power equipment set to worsen critical transformer shortage
date_evidence: 31 August 2026 (date line on the press release page)
key_claim: The order could affect a market of more than $22 billion in imports since 2025 across 24 nations, on top of estimated market shortages of 15% for power transformers and 8% for substations; data centres have turned to Chinese manufacturers to manage lead times.

title: Trump emergency order casts uncertainty over grid battery growth
